knowledge:
- key_parameters: ploidy=Specifies the ploidy of the yeast strain ("diploid" or "haploid") to apply the correct singlet/doublet gates in steadyState or summarizeFlow ;; only=Filters the events to analyze, typically "singlets" or "doublets" ;; mergeBy=The column name in the annotation data frame used to match and merge with the flowSet sampleNames (default is "name") ;; channel=The fluorescence channel(s) to be summarized in summarizeFlow (e.g., "FL1.A") ;; gated=Logical parameter in summarizeFlow; set to TRUE if the input flowSet has already been subsetted/gated
- alternatives: gate_flowClust_2d is deprecated in favor of gate_flowclust_2d for 2D gating ;; Gating can be performed on-the-fly during summarization using ploidy and only parameters with loadGates(), or pre-gated using Subset() and then summarized with gated = TRUE
- when_to_use: Use flowTime when analyzing flow cytometry datasets (steady-state or time-course) where experimental metadata needs to be integrated with flowSet objects, and automated gating (such as yeast population and singlet gating) is required for downstream statistical summarization and plotting.
- pitfalls: The sampleNames of the assembled flowSet must match the unique identifier column of the annotation dataframe exactly ;; Custom gates must be defined using the same transformation (e.g., logicle) as the dataset being analyzed ;; Budding yeast cultures contain debris and doublets that must be gated out to avoid introducing noise into signaling pathway measurements.

workflows.name: steady_state_analysis
workflows.intent: Analyze single time-point flow cytometry data by annotating, gating, and compiling individual events.
workflows.stages: 1. Import FCS files using read.flowSet ;; 2. Load metadata annotation using read.csv ;; 3. Annotate the flowSet using annotateFlowSet ;; 4. Load default gates using loadGates ;; 5. Gate and compile events using steadyState ;; 6. Plot the compiled events using ggplot
workflows.code:
plate1 <- read.flowSet ( path = system.file ( "extdata" , "ss_example" , package = "flowTime" ), alter.names = TRUE )
sampleNames (plate1) <- paste ( "1_" , sampleNames (plate1), sep = "" )
dat <- plate1
annotation <- read.csv ( system.file ( "extdata" , "ss_example.csv" , package = "flowTime" ))
adat <- annotateFlowSet ( yourFlowSet = dat, annotation_df = annotation, mergeBy = "name" )
loadGates ()
dat.SS <- steadyState ( flowset = adat, ploidy = "diploid" , only = "singlets" )
p <- ggplot (dat.SS, aes ( x = as.factor (treatment), y = FL2.A, fill = AFB)) + geom_boxplot ( outlier.shape = NA ) + facet_grid (IAA ~ AFB) + theme_classic ( base_family = "Arial" , base_size = 16 ) + ylim ( c ( - 1000 , 10000 )) + xlab ( expression ( paste ( "Auxin (" , mu, "M)" , sep = "" ))) + ylab ( "Fluorescence (AU)" ) + theme ( legend.position = "none" )
p

workflows.name: time_course_analysis
workflows.intent: Analyze time-lapse flow cytometry data by annotating, gating, and generating summary statistics per sample and time point.
workflows.stages: 1. Import FCS files using read.flowSet ;; 2. Load metadata annotation using read.csv ;; 3. Annotate the flowSet using annotateFlowSet ;; 4. Load cytometer-specific gates using loadGates ;; 5. Gate and summarize the flowSet using summarizeFlow ;; 6. Plot the summarized time-course data using qplot
workflows.code:
plate1 <- read.flowSet ( path = system.file ( "extdata" , "tc_example" , package = "flowTime" ), alter.names = TRUE )
sampleNames(plate1)<-paste('1_',sampleNames(plate1),sep='')
dat <- plate1
annotation <- read.csv ( system.file ( "extdata" , "tc_example.csv" , package = "flowTime" ))
adat <- annotateFlowSet (dat, annotation)
loadGates ( gatesFile = "C6Gates.RData" , path = system.file ( "extdata" , package = "flowTime" ))
dat_sum <- summarizeFlow (adat, ploidy = "diploid" , only = "singlets" , channel = "FL1.A" )
qplot ( x = time, y = FL1.Amean, data = dat_sum, linetype = factor (treatment)) + geom_line () + xlab ( "Time post Auxin addition (min)" ) + ylab ( "Reporter Fluorescence (AU)" ) + scale_color_discrete ( name = expression ( paste ( "Auxin (" , mu, "M)" , sep = "" ))) + theme_classic ( base_size = 14 , base_family = "Arial" )

workflows.name: custom_yeast_gating
workflows.intent: Create and save custom gating schemes (yeast population and singlet gates) from a flowSet.
workflows.stages: 1. Import and annotate flowSet using read.flowSet and annotateFlowSet ;; 2. Combine flowSet into a single frame for gate definition using fsApply ;; 3. Estimate and apply logicle transformation using estimateLogicle and transform ;; 4. Define yeast population gate using gate_flowClust_2d ;; 5. Reverse transform the gate and data using inverseLogicleTransform ;; 6. Define singlet gate using gate_singlet ;; 7. Save custom gates using saveGates
workflows.code:
data <- read.flowSet ( path = system.file ( "extdata" , "ss_example" , package = "flowTime" ), alter.names = TRUE )
annotation <- read.csv ( system.file ( "extdata" , "ss_example.csv" , package = "flowTime" ))
adat <- annotateFlowSet ( yourFlowSet = data, annotation_df = annotation, mergeBy = "name" )
library ( "openCyto" )
library ( "ggcyto" )
library ( "flowClust" )
data .1 frame <- data[[ 1 ]]
exprs (data .1 frame) <- fsApply (data, function (x) { x <- exprs (x) return (x) })
chnls <- c ( "FSC.A" , "SSC.A" , "FSC.H" , "SSC.H" )
trans <- estimateLogicle (data .1 frame, channels = chnls)
inv.trans <- inverseLogicleTransform (trans)
data .1 frame <- transform (data .1 frame, trans)
yeast <- gate_flowClust_2d (data .1 frame, xChannel = "FSC.A" , yChannel = "SSC.A" , K = 1 , quantile = 0.95 , min = c ( 0 , 0 ))
yeast <- transform (yeast, inv.trans)
data .1 frame <- transform (data .1 frame, inv.trans)
library (flowStats)
singlets <- gate_singlet ( x = Subset (data .1 frame, yeast), area = "FSC.A" , height = "FSC.H" , prediction_level = 0.999 , maxit = 20 )
saveGates ( yeastGate = yeast, dipsingletGate = singlets, fileName = "PSB_Accuri_W303.RData" )
